endings.name: The Architect Rises
endings.summary: Too much was forgotten: whatever answer is given at the choice fails, the shape Rhyla saw steps out of the Astral Expanse, and the sky fills with constellations no one has a name for.
endings.cost: Everything the world forgot stays forgotten. What steps through does not know it was a scholar. (Once scene 12, The Last Witness Is the Prisoner, exists and was reached, the voice loses its last word first: "I… remember…".)

endings.name: Remembered Whole
endings.summary: The party remembers who Izladar was, a Celestial Elf scholar; the Anchor holds his whole name and the voice finishes its sentence. The prison is sealed by memory, and now the whole world holds it, so no pair has to keep watch; he does not choose this. The dead witnesses stay dead. New cost (accepted 2026-11-15): a world that holds the seal by remembering can never let anything fade; grief does not soften in the six realms.
endings.cost: The dead witnesses stay dead, and their unrecorded names are read as blanks. A world that holds the seal by remembering can never let anything fade: grief does not soften in the six realms. Dorrin was half right.

endings.name: Dormant Again
endings.summary: The six pairs seal the wound by giving up the Twin-Soul Bond; the world is saved, and elves and dragons forget each other. Accepted 2026-11-15: once The Price is told (price_told), this is the ancestral bargain made again, with open eyes.
endings.cost: The bonds. It is the tribes' own bargain, the dragons' memory for the wall, chosen this time by those who pay it and knowing what it is.

endings.name: The Rememberer
endings.summary: One pair, chosen by the player (keeper_pair), stays at the heart of the wound to hold the name for good; the seal holds and the world slowly remembers. Also the result of a failed attempt to speak his whole name. Accepted 2026-11-15: the pair that stays does knowingly what the tribes did to their dragons blind.
endings.cost: That pair never goes home. A memory always has a carrier, and this time the carrier was asked. If Seraphyne keeps watch, the last shot is the sealed page in her lap, unopened.
